text:
Ben: Heliotrope sent acceptance criteria. They want a perf POC Wed: mixed workload (gen 65% / embed 35%), target sustained 160 rps, p95 < 220ms, p99 < 450ms. Also a monthly cost ballpark at ~50M tokens and confirmation on CMK/KMS. Can we run this on Dedicated?

Karina: Yep. I'll request infra. @Omar can you lead the runbook + load plan? Maya (CS), please prep the customer-facing note for demo.

Omar: I can take. Notes: 160rps is aggressive for 2 GPUs with larger models. Plan a poisson-ish burst pattern to mimic production: 40 -> 80 -> 120 -> 160 with 12m per step + 20m soak. Prewarm KV (5k short prefixes). Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens, error rate, and GPU telemetry. We'll run fp16 baseline and an int8 sweep if tail is decent.

Omar: Repro snippet (k6 + small JS mix):
```bash
# k6 script mixes gen/embed per ratio
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 12m scripts/heliotrope_mix.js --out json=run_40.json # adjust pacing to emulate RPS
# repeat for 80/120/160 then soak
```
(we also have a helper to inject Poisson timing on the client side).

Karina: alloc-bot, please reserve a dedicated-small (2x GPU slice) 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC for a 3h window. If int8 looks good we may shrink runtime.

alloc-bot: Allocation scheduled: dedicated-small start 2026-04-07T10:00:00Z duration 3h id alloc-zz19.

security-bot: CMK note: Dedicated + Private support customer-managed keys via KMS; HSM-backed keys available for Private installs. SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 summaries available.

Maya (CS): I'll craft the 1-pager for the demo: run schedule, high-level pricing ballpark, and where to find the security appendix. Will join the run.

Ben: Pricing ask: quick ballpark for 50M tokens. Back-of-envelope: hosted ~ $0.0007/token -> ~$35k/mo. Dedicated amortized (2-GPU) incl infra & ops ~ $18k-24k/mo at 60-80% util; 3-GPU headroom ~ $28k-34k. Omar please add assumptions (avg tokens/gen, avg tokens/embed, util %) in runbook.

Omar: Will include a small table: assumptions: avg tokens/gen=110, avg tokens/embed=16, mix 65/35, util scenarios 50/70/90%, and fp16 vs int8 throughput. Also compute cost per M tokens for each scenario.

Karina: Runbook checklist: 1) prewarm 10-15m, 2) stepped Poisson ramp 48m, 3) soak 20m, 4) capture k6 logs + prom snapshot + GPU telemetry, 5) abort if p99>900ms or error rate>2% or GPU mem>90%. Omar drop artifacts here after run.

Omar: Plan timeline: warmup 15m -> ramp 48m -> soak 20m -> post-checks 10m. I'll post run_40.json,...,run_160.json, soak.json, prom-snapshot.json and a 1-paragraph exec summary with key charts and suggested next steps (quantize or add slice).

Ben: Great. Maya will run the customer through the demo Friday if green. If tails look bad, we present options: smaller model variant, aggressive quantization, or add a third GPU slice with cost tradeoffs.

Maya (CS): I'll prep customer messaging templates for each outcome. Ping me when run starts. :thumbsup:
